protocols.purpose: Declare executable cross-plane laws for continuity, authority, time, replay safety, capability disclosure, intent preservation, proof convergence and failover
Carry causally addressed agent/model/voice/device/proof messages with logical HZ semantics, freshness, consequence and capability disclosure
Bind AURO/MESIE compute into POCKET logical model, intel, proof and recovery channels while preserving the physical-Hz boundary and no-side-effect authority
Correlate bounded AURO/MESIE compute evidence with request identity without granting authorization authority

federation_rules: request identity survives every transport hop
logical HZ is semantic/cadence metadata and not a physical RF claim
model or scientific compute never creates external-side-effect authority
side-effecting consumers require approval and replay-safety semantics
success requiring evidence is not verified until execution and proof converge
transport failover preserves envelope identity and discloses changed trust/privacy/durability semantics
claim_boundary: This extension defines interoperability contracts and authority boundaries. It does not prove every listed transport adapter or component path is deployed end-to-end.
